about.title: About WonderReel
about.subtitle: Little films, big lessons — made safely for families.
about.intro: WonderReel helps parents turn a short story idea into a gentle educational film for children. You stay in control: nothing reaches your child until you preview and approve it.
about.step1_body: Describe a lesson or adventure on the home page — colors, numbers, animals, and more.
about.step2_body: AI turns your prompt into a short video. You review it first — approve or discard.
about.step3_title: Hand the device to your child
about.step3_body: Kid Mode shows only approved films. No prompts, no settings — just watch and learn.
about.safety_body: Every film waits in your review queue before it appears in Kid Mode. Use a nickname for your viewer — real names are never required.
